Remark
[Properties of stable hyperbolic limits] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0237 ↗ def:chow-iv-stable-hyperbolic-limit 1. ch33:33.3\group Hyperbolic pieces

The boundary and the side selected by $\mathcal M_{A(t)}(t)$ vary smoothly; the pieces converge pointedly and smoothly to $(\mathcal H,h)$; fixed truncation tori become concave and asymptotically totally umbilic. The stable submanifold itself need not be unique.
